aiVerification.summary: The draft has citeable defect-result evidence but the changed-factor grouping and added measurement outcomes are not reliable.
issues: Baseline mixes Baotou special lot normal, Ruijin normal lot, and later date normal condition.
Critical subgroup keys are missing: date, vendor/lot/material condition, and process setting.
Measurement outcomes are parser artifacts from table text, not real measurements.
Rows 15 and 19-23 are cited but not shown in context, limiting verification of listed conditions.
Changed factor over-combines temperature, dry time, cleaning method, and material lot without clear hierarchy.
requiredUserQuestions: Are 4/14 Baotou and 4/15 Ruijin trials intended as separate subgroups or one combined validation?
correctionPlan: Remove all measurement-* outcomes and keep only the defect result table.
Rebuild cf-1 as improvement-condition testing for MG+Yoke separation, with subgroup keys for date and material vendor/lot.
Separate baseline rows by subgroup: Baotou normal for 4/14 tests and Ruijin normal for 4/15 dry-time tests.
Verify and include row text for cited rows 15 and 19-23 before final use.
Keep Input, NG, and NG rate as the only outcome metrics with not_judged judgement unless a decision row supports a conclusion.
